title: Checkout 500s: database disk full
symptoms: POST /payments returned 500 for 25 minutes. Driver errors: could not extend file, No space left on device.
root_cause: Postgres data volume filled up after audit-log table growth; writes failed.
fix: Expanded the volume and added a 80% disk usage alert. Moved audit logs to cold storage.

title: JPY totals shown with decimals
symptoms: Receipts for JPY orders showed totals like 1200.00 instead of 1200.
root_cause: Display layer formatted every currency with 2 decimals; JPY has none. Amounts were correct.
fix: Format by currency minor units in the receipt template.

title: 401s for all EU users
symptoms: EU traffic got 401 on every authenticated request for 40 minutes. US traffic unaffected.
root_cause: TLS certificate on the EU auth proxy expired; the proxy stripped the session header.
fix: Renewed the certificate and added expiry monitoring.

title: Refund amounts off by one cent
symptoms: About 0.3% of partial refunds were one cent lower than requested. Reconciliation flagged mismatches.
root_cause: Partial refund calculation used float arithmetic before rounding.
fix: Switched refund maths to Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP; documented the Decimal rule in docs/payments.md.

title: Customers charged twice from mobile app
symptoms: Duplicate charges for the same order, mostly from iOS. Reconciliation reported DuplicateCharge.
root_cause: The iOS app generated a new Idempotency-Key on every retry, so the server's idempotency check could not match retries.
fix: iOS app now uses the order ID as the Idempotency-Key. Server-side idempotency check unchanged; added a reconciliation alert.

title: 401 spike on one API instance
symptoms: About 20% of requests got 401 for an hour, all served by api-3.
root_cause: NTP stopped on api-3; its clock drifted 70 minutes ahead, so fresh tokens looked expired.
fix: Restarted NTP, added clock-drift alerting per instance.

title: Payment history page slow
symptoms: Customer payment history took 6-10 s. Slow query logs showed full scans on payments.

title: Gateway outage
symptoms: 502s from the card gateway for 15 minutes; our retries with backoff kept load normal.
root_cause: Provider-side outage at the card gateway.
fix: None needed on our side; followed the provider's incident.

title: Webhook 400s after gateway API upgrade
symptoms: /webhooks/gateway returned 400 missing field 'id' for a subset of events.
root_cause: Gateway API version 2026-04 moved the charge id from data.id to data.object.id for refund events.
fix: Pinned the webhook API version in the gateway dashboard.

title: Too many connections from nightly export job
symptoms: OperationalError: too many connections at 02:00 nightly; API 500s for 10 minutes.
root_cause: The nightly CSV export job leaked connections: it opened one per batch and never closed them.
fix: Export job now uses a single pooled connection with a context manager.

title: Payment API 500s after pool size increase
symptoms: POST /payments returned 500 shortly after a deploy. Logs: OperationalError: too many connections; requests waited for the pool timeout (5 s).
root_cause: A performance change raised DB_POOL_SIZE from 20 to 60. With 5 instances that is 300 connections against Postgres max_connections of 100.
fix: Restored DB_POOL_SIZE to 20 and documented the pool × instances ≤ max_connections rule in docs/database.md.

title: Webhook signature failures after secret rotation
symptoms: All gateway webhooks rejected with invalid signature for 30 minutes.
root_cause: Webhook secret was rotated in the gateway but the vault value was updated an hour later.
fix: Rotation runbook now updates the vault first and supports two secrets during rotation.

title: Staging down after env file refactor
symptoms: Staging returned 500 on every request: MissingSetting: environment variable PAYSTREAM_DATABASE_URL is not set.
root_cause: The staging env file was reorganised and the database URL line was dropped.
fix: Restored the line; added the REQUIRED_ENV check to the deploy checklist.

title: Gateway rate limiting during bulk refunds
symptoms: 429 Too Many Requests from the gateway; refunds and live payments failed for 20 minutes.
root_cause: A one-off bulk refund script retried failed calls in a tight loop with no backoff.
fix: Script now uses the shared gateway client with exponential backoff. Backoff rule added to docs/architecture.md.

title: Support console search slow during bulk import
symptoms: User search took 3-5 s for one hour while 400k users were imported.
root_cause: Database CPU saturated by the bulk import; queries were index-backed but starved.
fix: Imports now run off-peak and throttled.
